u0: The agent is carrying the box and the box has not just slipped, so the obligation to recatch a fall is not pending and the task is to keep heading for the exit. Reaching the exit normally completes the task; if the box falls on this step the next move must pick it up.
u1: The box has just slipped out of the agent's hands. On the very next step the agent must pick it up again; if it does, play returns to ordinary progress needing to reach the exit with the box, and if it does not, the promise is broken and the task fails.
u2: The agent is standing on the exit while holding the box (or has just regained it after a fall on the exit step), so the goal of reaching the exit carrying the box is satisfied and the task is complete.
u3: The box fell on the step the agent reached the exit, so the recatch obligation is still pending even though the exit has been reached. The box must be picked up again on the next move; if it is, the task succeeds, and if not, the requirement is violated and the task fails.
u4: A mandatory requirement has been broken: after a fall the agent did not pick the box up on the very next move, or it reached the exit without the box in hand. Successful completion is no longer possible.
